name: gratovo-toolbox
description: Gratovo's internal desktop app: Electron, React and TypeScript, with the Python pipeline and Supabase.

scripts.lint: eslint . && prettier --check . && uv run --directory services/pipeline ruff check . && uv run --directory services/pipeline ruff format --check .
scripts.format: prettier --write . && uv run --directory services/pipeline ruff format .
scripts.typecheck: pnpm -r --workspace-concurrency=1 typecheck && uv run --directory services/pipeline pyright
scripts.test: vitest run && pnpm --filter @gratovo/desktop test:e2e && uv run --directory services/pipeline pytest
